approval_anchor.reason: Denim basic-colour Neutral applies only to conventional Denim product contexts (Trouser/Jeans · Denim Jacket · Skirt); Navy joins the Denim basic palette; an ineligible Denim category bypasses BOTH the Denim Neutral rule and the ordinary Category×Color Neutral Registry and resolves from intrinsic colour-family semantics.
approval_anchor.affected_scope: STMX_EI_DIRECTION_RUNTIME_V1_2_6 Stage 2.5 + startingState + this contract + Denim tests. ⛔ D7 · D8 · Registry V2 rows · Base Character · Colour V1 schema · P3 force contract unchanged.

eligibility_predicates.Trouser: category = Trouser ∧ material includes Denim — the Trouser/Jeans conventional denim product context. The governed Jeans product context (trouser_distinction = Jeans, Registry V2 §5 · CEO D-J6) is ALSO available and is recorded in the trace for every Denim trouser; eligibility itself is category-level because the CEO ineligible list (§7) is expressed entirely in categories. ⚠ CEO REVIEW ITEM: if eligibility is meant to be the narrower Jeans product context only, this predicate must be narrowed — see DN-ELIG-REVIEW-1 (0 corpus units affected today: every governed Denim trouser in the corpus carries trouser_distinction = Jeans).
eligibility_predicates.Jacket: category = Jacket ∧ material includes Denim — the same predicate the Registry V2 §4 Jacket chain already uses for its Jacket · Denim context.

ineligible_note: The canonical category vocabulary is exactly [T-Shirt · Shirt · Sweater · Sweatshirt · Jacket · Coat · Trouser · Skirt · Dress · Jumpsuit] (producer_rules_v1.js). "Blouse" in the CEO order is not a canonical category; it falls under Shirt, which is ineligible. Eligibility is a CLOSED allow-list: any category not in eligible_categories is ineligible, so a future category is ineligible by default until the CEO says otherwise.
eligible_rule: material includes Denim ∧ category ∈ {Trouser · Jacket · Skirt}: primary_color_family ∈ {black · gray · blue · navy} → CONTEXTUAL_NEUTRAL; any other Base-Character family → E_BASE.
ineligible_rule: material includes Denim ∧ category ∉ eligible: (a) NO Denim Neutral, (b) BYPASS the ordinary Category×Color Neutral Registry — an ineligible Denim garment must not regain Neutral through a row it would otherwise hit, (c) resolve from the intrinsic colour-family semantics (Registry V2 §1 Base Character), (d) continue through EI evidence normally.
denim_is_not_evidence: ⛔ The Denim material itself is NEVER admitted as EI P3 evidence. This decision governs Neutral eligibility/routing ONLY. No "Denim in an unusual category = Meaningful" pathway exists or may be created.
lightness_non_requirement: ⛔ color_lightness is not part of any predicate (EI-X-D9 preserved).
unresolvable_family_rule: primary_color_family that is not a Base-Character family (Colour V1 'uncertain') stays UNRESOLVED in every branch — never promoted to Expressive (fail-closed, EI-X-D2).

order: Stage 2.5 material/category routing — IF material = Denim: eligible → Denim basic rule decides · ineligible → Registry bypass + intrinsic semantics · ELSE fall through
Stage 3 Category×Color Neutral Registry (skipped for ALL Denim garments)
precedence.no_downgrade: ⛔ An eligible-Denim non-basic E_BASE is never downgraded afterwards by generic Non-Expressive family semantics.

no_name_guessing: ⛔ Eligibility is derived from the governed category observation and the governed material observation only. No string matching on descriptors or file names.
